188:t_1:83.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's the original name for dimensional power. It's also called the power of the fundamental principle.」

188:t_1:85.en:
$$アルト$$
「Now I have some idea why $$バルビエル$$ tried to recruit $n.」

188:t_1:86.en:
$$シン$$
「That guy... He's a Reactor in the Empire?」

188:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes... His cunning tactics are as great a threat as his combat strength.」

188:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「But I've heard $c has several people with $$スフィア$$s too.」

188:t_1:90.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry to disappoint you, $$レド$$, but $$セツコ$$, $n, and I are still pretty green compared to the Empire's Reactors...」

188:t_1:91.en:
$$ランド$$
「And that bastard $$バルビエル$$ hasn't shown us his full power either.」

188:t_1:92.en:
$n
「Neither did $$尸空#pilot$$, who we fought at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$...」

188:t_1:94.en:
$n
「Yes... I think he probably came to investigate us because we'd destroyed the $$時の牢獄$$.」

188:t_1:95.en:
$$シン$$
「He was clearly holding back then.」

188:t_1:96.en:
$$宗介$$
「But worn down by consecutive battles and badly battered after fighting him, we couldn't stop $$サイデリアル$$'s invasion afterward...」

188:t_1:97.en:
$$アルト$$
「You could say he created the situation Earth is in now.」

188:t_1:98.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So we've got to pay that bastard back.」

188:t_1:99.en:
$$マオ$$
「The whole $$蒼の地球$$ does, along with us.」

188:t_1:100.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We fought him on $$翠の地球$$ too, before we joined $c...」

188:t_1:101.en:
$$メール$$
「Honestly, the thought of fighting that gloomy assassin again gets me down...」

188:t_1:108.en:
$$シン$$
「If $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$ felt it too...」

188:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ coming...!?」

188:t_2:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Where has the $$クラッシャー隊$$ been all this time!? Earth's in serious trouble!」

188:t_2:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm sorry. But we were on a mission too.」

188:t_2:7.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「The $$クラッシャー隊$$ has spent these past two months surveying the solar system.」

188:t_2:9.en:
$$ナオト$$
「To investigate the effects of the $$時の牢獄$$'s destruction.」

188:t_2:10.en:
$$アキラ$$
「There are two Earths and two Moons in our solar system now, but only one of each other planet.」

188:t_2:11.en:
$$ミカ$$
「Scientists say the two worlds overlap within the solar system, but the area around Earth exists separately for each world.」

188:t_2:12.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Put simply, it's the same situation as when two Japanese archipelagos existed in $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

188:t_2:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「Of course not...! I'm just pretending!」

188:t_2:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「While surveying the planets in the solar system, we found a few things that concern us.」

188:t_2:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「First, we found an area near the edge of the solar system where the dimensional boundary is extremely distorted.」

188:t_2:21.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「We thought it might be something $$サイデリアル$$ uses for extremely long-range spatial travel, but...」

188:t_2:22.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Judging by their movements, that doesn't seem to be the case.」

188:t_2:23.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「So you couldn't determine the cause, or what it's like inside the distortion?」

188:t_2:25.en:
$$ミカ$$
「We brought back observation data, so we plan to examine it thoroughly later.」

188:t_2:26.en:
$$アキラ$$
「The other surprise was finding people living on Saturn.」

188:t_2:28.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「More precisely, on its moon Titan, rather than Saturn itself.」

188:t_2:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well, well... So you've found them.」

188:t_2:31.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ニコラス・バセロン$$. I'm a member of $$フラタニティ$$.」

188:t_2:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... You're one of their companions on Titan.」

188:t_2:33.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm $$明神タケル$$. I hope we'll work well together.」

188:t_2:34.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! He's a classic handsome super robot pilot!」

188:t_2:35.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I get it, so stop making such a fuss. It's embarrassing.」

188:t_2:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「Huh... So that's your type, $$ノノ$$.」

188:t_2:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! He has exactly the air of a hero of justice!」

188:t_2:38.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hang on a minute, Sis $$ノノ$$!」

188:t_2:39.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Never mind handsome! Aren't we the classic type too!?」

188:t_2:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You, $$ワッ太$$, and $$正太郎$$ are a little too young, $$勝平$$.」

188:t_2:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To be the classic type, you have to be at an age where you combine adult strength and childlike purity!」

188:t_2:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sheesh... I don't want to hear that from someone with an adult body and a child's brain...」

188:t_2:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$. You, $$勝平$$, and $$正太郎$$ will all grow up soon.」

188:t_2:44.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's it! That's exactly it! That refreshing charm is absolutely essential to the classic type!」

188:t_2:45.en:
$$恵子$$
「You're the same as ever, $$タケル$$.」

188:t_2:46.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Yes. That's one of $$マーズ$$'s good points.」

188:t_2:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You can just call me $$ニコラ$$.」

188:t_2:49.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Then, $$ニコラ$$... We were refused permission to dock at the base on Titan.」

188:t_2:50.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「They called themselves $$トップレス$$ too. They must be your companions. Do you have any idea why they refused?」

188:t_2:51.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The $$トップレス$$' mission is to intercept $$宇宙怪獣$$. Beyond that, they probably don't intend to engage much with people from this world.」

188:t_2:52.en:
$$ナオト$$
「But you're part of $c, aren't you?」
